activity.notes: The 1972 Socialist Constitution created the office of President of the DPRK, and Kim Il Sung assumed that state-head office in December 1972. He remained President until his death on 8 July 1994. ATLAS records this presidency separately from his preceding premiership.

sources.title: 김일성 — 북한정보포털, 통일부
sources.citation_text: The Ministry of Unification chronology records Kim Il Sung as State President from December 1972 and his death in July 1994.

sources.title: 정치체제 형성 — 북한정보포털, 통일부
sources.citation_text: The Ministry of Unification explains that the 1972 Socialist Constitution abolished the prior cabinet system and established the presidency as the state's supreme office.

sources.title: Kim Il-Sung — Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Kim Il Sung as president and head of state of North Korea from 1972 until his death in 1994.
